# 리트젠 LICHTZEN

> 1995년 설립한 한국의 광응용 제조기업. UV 램프(수은·메탈할라이드·갈륨)·MIR/NIR 램프·UV LED 모듈과 UV 경화·IR/MIR 건조 시스템을 설계·제조합니다. 본사·공장·연구소: 경기도 군포시. ISO 9001·ISO 14001.

## 주요 페이지

- [제품 찾기](https://www.lichtzen.com/products/): UV 경화 장비, UV LED, IR·MIR 건조, 램프·광원, UV-C 살균, 부품
- [UV-C 소독 솔루션](https://www.lichtzen.com/uvc-disinfection/): Wonder-Ray® 254nm UV-C 소독기(S8W4·S8), 222nm Far-UVC 모듈, 시험·인증, 적용 공간
- [적용 분야](https://www.lichtzen.com/solutions/): 필름·인쇄·코팅, PCB, 정밀 본딩, IR 가열·건조
- [기술](https://www.lichtzen.com/technology/): 광원 선택과 공정 검토
- [회사소개](https://www.lichtzen.com/company/): 연혁, 조직, 특허·인증
- [상담·견적](https://www.lichtzen.com/contact/): 제품·공정 문의

## English pages

LICHTZEN Co., Ltd. (Gunpo, Korea, founded 1995) designs and manufactures UV and IR light sources, UV curing and IR/MIR drying systems, and UV LED modules. Every page below is the English version of the Korean page at the same path without /en. Chinese, Japanese, Hindi and Spanish versions are at /zh/, /ja/, /hi/ and /es/.

- [UV Curing Systems, Custom Equipment & Conveyors | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/): Korean maker of UV/IR light sources and curing and drying equipment since 1995: UV lamps, UV LEDs, MIR lamps, custom UV curing systems and conveyors.
- [About LICHTZEN | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/company/): LICHTZEN, founded 1995 in Gunpo, Korea, makes UV/IR light sources and curing equipment, with head office, factory and R&D center on one site.
- [Careers | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/company/careers/): Careers at LICHTZEN: design, manufacturing and R&D roles in UV/IR light sources and curing and drying equipment. Contact Management Support to apply.
- [Patents & Certifications | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/company/certifications/): LICHTZEN patents, utility models and trademarks, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and CE certifications, and awards. Scope and validity are shown on each certificate.
- [Greeting | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/company/greeting/): CEO message: since 1995 LICHTZEN has developed and made UV and MIR lamps, UV curing and IR drying systems, and UV/IR LED curing systems.
- [History | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/company/history/): LICHTZEN history since 1995: spot UV curing units, MIR drying systems, UV LED curing units and disinfection devices.

- [Contact | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/contact/): Ask about UV curing equipment, custom systems, conveyors, replacement UV lamps and parts. Only company, email and message are required.
- [Conveyors | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/conveyors/): Ohsung Unicon conveyors: standard belt, center drive, inclined, curved, right-angle, chain, mesh and roller types. Discuss the right setup for your line.

- [Area Type UV LED | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/area-uv-led/): Area Type UV LED: 365/385/395/405 nm, air or water cooled, with irradiation area designed for OCA/OCR bonding and display curing.
- [UV System for Bonding | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/bonding-uv-system/): Nitrogen (N₂) purged UV system for bonding. Blocking oxygen improves curing quality; used for coating and printing on PET film, glass, paper and PVD thin films.
- [Camera Module & LCD Bonding UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/camera-module-bonding/): Compact conveyor UV system for camera module and LCD bonding, curing below 60 °C for heat-sensitive PCBs, electronic parts and semiconductors.
- [Ultra-High-Pressure Capillary & GL Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/capillary-gl-lamps/): Ultra-high-pressure capillary and GL instant-start lamps deliver high UV in a short time for exposure and plate-making. Non-standard sizes available.
- [Compact Multi-purpose UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/compact-uv-system/): Compact multi-purpose UV system with adjustable distance, conveyor speed and lamp height for testing and producing electronic parts, resins and phone modules.
- [UNI-CON Aluminium Frame Conveyor | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/conveyor/): UNI-CON extruded aluminium frame conveyor: anodized for corrosion resistance and strength, with T-slots to mount sensors, cylinders and brackets anywhere.
- [LCD & Display Printing UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/display-printing-uv/): LCD and display printing UV system with a particle-free belt, suction system and digital temperature and speed control for curing display materials.
- [Double-sided PCB Curing UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/double-sided-pcb-uv/): Double-sided PCB curing UV system. Roller and value types keep top/bottom UV intensity variation within ±5%, using mercury, metal halide or ozone-free lamps.
- [LMX & LGX Exposure Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/exposure-lamps/): LMX (metal halide) and LGX (gallium) exposure lamps: continuous 265–420 nm emission, 200–600 W/cm, with non-standard sizes available.
- [Far-UVC 222 nm Disinfection Module for Occupied Spaces | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/far-uvc-222nm/): 222 nm Far-UVC disinfection module for use with people present. Types A (6 W), B and C; 99.9% reduction of E. coli and S. enterica (KCL); skin TLV 479 mJ/cm².
- [FAR-UVC Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/far-uvc-lamps/): FAR-UVC 222 nm excimer lamp. A germicidal light source in the 200–230 nm far-UV range that inactivates pathogens within exposure guidelines.
- [Film, PMMA, PC & PET Coating UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/film-print-coating/): Film, PMMA, PC and PET printing and coating UV system for BLU and light guide plate production, with an ion blower and ionizer to reduce static and particles.
- [Gallium (Ga) Lamp | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/gallium-uv-lamp/): Gallium (Ga) UV lamps emit 400–450 nm (peak 420 nm) for curing heavily pigmented paints and coatings over 30 μm. See specifications by model.
- [Handheld UV Curing Unit | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/handheld-uv-curing/): Handheld UV curing unit with a parabolic reflector for even wide-area curing of PCB coatings, UV resins and adhesives, and glass, plastic and metal bonding.
- [Ultra-compact & Laboratory UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/laboratory-uv-system/): Ultra-compact and laboratory UV system. A benchtop lab curing unit using mercury, metal halide or ozone-free lamps, with an optional band-pass filter.
- [Lamp Accessories | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/lamp-accessories/): UV lamp accessories. See the specification tables for ceramic and metal bases; non-standard specifications are made to suit your use.
- [Linear Type UV LED | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/linear-uv-led/): Linear Type UV LED. 365/385/395/405 nm, lengths of 100–2,100 mm, air or water cooled. A module for line-irradiation curing on printing, coating and film lines.
- [Ultra-low-temperature UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/low-temperature-uv-system/): Ultra-low-temperature UV system for surface modification of printer and copier rollers, with uniform internal temperature and 3 to 20 lamps.
- [Mercury (Hg) Lamp | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/mercury-uv-lamp/): High-pressure mercury (Hg) UV lamps rich in 365 nm, made to order at 50–200 W/cm for coating, curing and printing under 15 μm. Specs by model.
- [Metal Halide (Fe) Lamp | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/metal-halide-uv-lamp/): Metal halide (Fe) UV lamp. Emits from 265 to 420 nm centred on 365 nm, made to order from 50 to 200 W/cm. For thick paint coatings and colored printing.
- [MIR Drying System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/mir-drying-systems/): MIR drying systems use 2–6 μm medium-wave infrared to dry water-based paints and polymer coatings fast, on battery and automotive lines.
- [MIR Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/mir-lamps/): MIR lamps (2–6 μm) for drying automotive water-based paints, heating plastics and drying glass coatings, made in lengths of 300–2,000 mm.
- [NIR Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/nir-lamps/): NIR (near-infrared) lamps. Short 0.8–1.5 μm wavelengths pass through the air and transfer heat directly to the object for fast heating and drying. 300–2,000 mm.
- [OLED & AMOLED Panel UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/oled-amoled-uv-system/): OLED/AMOLED panel UV system curing OCR/OCA bonds of cover glass and touch panels below 60 °C with left-right variation within 10%.
- [PCB Printing & Coating UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/pcb-print-coating/): Conveyor UV system for curing PCB screen printing and coatings, with focusing reflectors and special quartz tubes to cut operator exposure and heat.
- [Roll Coater UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/roll-coater-uv-system/): Roll coater UV system. UV or IR is chosen to suit the roll coating line, and coating thickness and roller material and size are built to order.
- [Roll Surface Treatment UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/roll-surface-treatment/): Roll surface treatment UV system for low-temperature curing of film, PMMA, PC and PET, with constant-power feedback, clean chamber and suction.
- [ROLL-TO-ROLL UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/roll-to-roll-uv-system/): Roll-to-roll UV curing for film and TSP: 3–16 kW mercury or metal halide lamps, 300–1,500 mm curing width and various coater combinations.
- [Drawer-type SOLAR CELL UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/solar-cell-uv-system/): Drawer-type lab UV system for solar cell process development, combining heating and UV curing with settable time, height and output (80–120 W/cm).
- [Spot Type LED Applications | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/spot-led-applications/): Spot Type LEDs from 265 to 1,020 nm (UVC to IR) with a 10–100% dimming, PLC-ready controller for precision bonding and inspection.
- [SPOT UV Curing Unit | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/spot-uv-curing/): SPOT UV curing unit. A light guide concentrates UV on a specific area to cure thick adhesives quickly, with PLC integration and foot-switch shutter control.
- [SPOT UV LED | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/spot-uv-led/): Spot UV LED LS4. 365–405 nm, instant on without warm-up and low-temperature curing without IR. A compact spot curing unit with no mercury or ozone.
- [Special Curved-surface (3D) UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/three-dimensional-uv/): 3D curved-surface UV system curing the sides and top of tubes, cosmetic containers and other curved products evenly at once, built to product size.
- [UV Cleaning Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/uv-cleaning-lamps/): UV cleaning lamps remove organic films under a few hundred Å from semiconductor, OLED, optical glass and lead frame surfaces. Air or water cooled.
- [UV Filters | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/uv-filters/): UV filters (cold mirror and hot mirror). They release lamp heat (infrared) and increase UV reflection, curing heat-sensitive products without deformation.
- [UV Lamp Applications | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/uv-lamp-applications/): UV lamp applications by industry — printing, coating, bonding, electronics, optics and disinfection — and the benefits of UV-curable coatings.
- [UV Module System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/uv-module-system/): Modular UV curing system with standardized modules for 1–40 kW lamps, easy to fit to optical film, offset, gravure and screen printing lines.
- [UV Power Supplies | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/uv-power-supplies/): UV power supplies: electronic ballasts (constant current/power, onshore and marine), capacitor and choke transformers, and igniters for UV lamps.
- [UV Reflectors | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/uv-reflectors/): UV reflectors. Choose focusing, parallel or diffuse construction to suit the process. Compare reflector shapes for print curing and semiconductor bonding.
- [WAFER TAPE REMOVER UV System | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/wafer-tape-remover/): WAFER TAPE REMOVER UV system. A UV curing unit for stable removal of wafer tape, built per wafer size with optional nitrogen (N₂) purging.
- [Water & Seawater Treatment Lamps | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/water-treatment-lamps/): Low-pressure 253.7 nm germicidal UV lamps for wastewater, industrial and drinking water, ballast water (BWTS) and HVAC air purification.
- [Wonder-Ray® 254 nm UV-C Disinfection Device (S8W4, S8) | LICHTZEN](https://www.lichtzen.com/en/products/wonder-ray-254nm/): Mobile 254 nm UV-C disinfector for patient rooms, ICUs and isolation rooms: 12 lamps, 99.999%+ (5 log) efficacy, 360° motion detection, 0.007 ppm ozone, KC registered.
